Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Ashiqur Rahman Shibli and Jishan Alam to open for Bangladesh. Gulshan Jha to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

For Nepal, it was all about one partnership. Dev Khanal and Bishal Bikram KC came in when their team was struggling but both weathered the storm and build the innings pretty well. Bishal Bikram KC was dropped in his 20s but got out just two short of his fifty. Not a bit score but we know how skilful Nepal bowlers are. They are known for their bowling. For sure, this won't be an easy chase for Bangladesh Under-19. An interesting chase coming up. Stay tuned.

A clinical performance from Bangladesh Under-19 but they have done a lot more better. They had a chance to keep n under 150 but they dropped a couple of catches and allowed the tail to wag a bit. The good thing was, they were right on the money from the start. The seamers especially started really well. The spinners then came in and continued the good work. Sheikh Paevez Jibon ended with three wickets while Md Rohanat Doullah Borson took four as well.

OUT! GONE! Md Rohanat Doullah Borson ends with four. Short in length and outside off. Durgesh Gupta looks to pull but gets a top edge, high and to point. The keeper calls and takes it well. Nepal Under-19 END WITH 169.

TOSS - Nepal Under-19 have won the toss and ELECTED TO BAT!

It is time for yet another match in the Super Sixes and it is time for Nepal Under-19 to take on Bangladesh Under-19. Two Asian teams face off each other in a crucial match. Both teams have some quality bowlers to look forward to and at Mangaung Oval, Bloemfontein, the ball tends to do a lot more than other places. So, we feel whoever bowls better will have the upper hand in the game. Bangladesh Under-19 lost their opening match but won their last two matches comprehensively. They look favourites but don't sleep on Nepal Under-19 who have upset Afghanistan in the last match and will love to put on a similar performance against another Asian team. A lot to look forward to in this match. The toss will be really crucial. Stay tuned.
...MATCH DAY...

It is time for the Super Six stage of the ICC Under-19 World Cup 2024. We are awaiting match number 4 where Nepal Under-19 will go up against Bangladesh Under-19 at the Mangaung Oval in Bloemfontein. This is expected to be a thrilling encounter between these two teams from Asia. Bangladesh Under-19 started off their campaign with a loss against India Under-19 but their bowling performance was very impressive in that game. They bounced back strongly against Ireland Under-19 and won that match comfortably. Maruf Mridha and Sheikh Paevez Jibon have been consistent with the ball and they will want to keep it that way because the tournament only gets more crucial after this stage. Ashiqur Rahman Shibli and Adil Bin Siddik gave a strong start to their batting innings followed by an equally strong end by Md Shihab James and Ahrar Amin to finish off the game. They have been performing well in this tournament and they will want the momentum in their favor. Nepal Under-19 on the other hand has faced two losses. One against their counterparts from New Zealand and the other against Pakistan. Both of them were strong teams but the Nepal Under-19 put up a good performance in both the games. Their batting was the topic of concern in both games because there were not many runs on the board for the bowlers to defend. They will have to focus on building strong partnerships. Bipin Rawal and Dev Khanal have been in good touch with the bat but apart from them, the others are crumbling under pressure. Their bowling unit looks good and they impressed everyone with their performance against New Zealand in their first game. In their last match, Aakash Chand took a three-wicket haul with Dipesh Kandel and Aakash Tripathi supporting him with one wicket each. They are again put up against a strong team and they have the caliber to cause a massive upset in this competition. Which team are you supporting in this exciting contest?
